sentences: The comment says one step of selection sort, so doing that once gives the sorted array.
Finding the smallest value means putting 1 first, and the rest just fall into order after that.
A pass over the whole array checks every element, so after one pass everything ends up sorted.
The code finds the smallest and swaps it to the front, which arranges all four numbers in order.
Since one step handles the smallest value, the other numbers automatically follow from smallest to largest.
